==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. Johnson is confident that the wielder is still alive. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet.) (The Black Wielder resembles a faceless humanoid made of black stone collapsed on the ground next to a black stone trident.)
He says that the black stone on the wielder is actually a shell. (I looked this up after I woke up, and apparently stones can form a black coating on them called Black Lichen. Black Lichen is made up of symbiotic algae and fungi that forms on rocks on the shoreline overtime. This makes sense because the Golden Wielder defended the Cosmic Sea for many years, until it was eventually taken over by the Ruby symbiote. The Ruby symbiote forming on him likely was a similar process to the formation of Black Lichen, but on a cosmic scale. What is so fascinating about this, is that I had never heard of Black Lichen before but I very clearly dreamed about it. This isn't the first time I've learned real world information I'd never heard before in a dream. I learned the Latin word for endless in a dream a few months ago. It is always pretty surprising to have these real world downloads occur in my dreams.)
I used geomancy to shake him until the shell cracked off of him, revealing his true golden glow beneath.
